title: Verify final audit source and Oracle delivery as a complete release

spec.problem: Release all accumulated audited product source from current origin/main, preserve earlier local audit records as historical evidence, and configure Oracle delivery after successful exact-SHA CI.

acceptance.text: Adopt every final product source/test/schema change; preserve private/generated local state and archived audit evidence without treating old incomplete tasks as release verification.
Canonical Go, frontend and harness suites run with no unexpected skips; focused regression sensitivity demonstrates assertions detect broken implementations.
A successful CI push on main releases only its validated SHA to Oracle through the registered ARM64 runner; failed CI and PR events never deploy.

Pre-release learner/Admin real UI login and critical browser checks pass; prepare private operator credentials and document mandatory production URL/RBAC verification after CI-gated deployment. Production evidence is recorded after push, not claimed as pre-release verification.

spec.expected_behavior: All final product changes pass fresh canonical suites, security review, meaningful sensitivity checks, real browser checks and exact-SHA gated Oracle deployment.
spec.observed_behavior: Remote main lacks accumulated API/UI/schema fixes and OCI delivery; historical task records are incomplete and cannot substitute for a verified release.
spec.rollback_plan: Preserve the original checkout and 193 local commits. Oracle backs up PostgreSQL before additive forward migrations, retains immutable prior app images/config, and rolls app images back on failed readiness; never reset data or run seeds. Existing migration history is preserved.

red_exception.reason: This consolidated release introduces complete handler/store interfaces, the lifecycle harness and OCI release modules absent from origin/main. Restoring the entire base cannot compile/import the final component tests. Preserve historical individual RED attempts separately and verify a production mutation plus complete canonical suites on the adopted final source.

risk_acknowledgements.reason: Requires a real disposable PostgreSQL/Redis fixture. Canonical local verification and CI provision both; the zero-skip ratchet remains enforced, with no skip-baseline additions.

Local runtime option starts the canonical existing stack; test discovery is preserved. Two browser-only wrappers were relocated from Vitest to e2e/admin-audit-mobile.spec.ts with their original assertions. They need the developer's local-audit fixtures and are NOT part of the release browser gate or CI; the release gate is scripts/release/browser-release.mjs against a stack built from this tree.
Run the separate lifecycle/adversarial harness tests through the mandatory suite_harness gate, retaining required-file discovery and zero skips.
Separate lifecycle self-tests from frontend tests; suite_harness remains mandatory and no required assertions or skip accounting is removed.
Detector matched its own forbidden-pattern regular expression. This rejects swallowed failures; it does not execute a failure-swallowing command.
The Skip is text in an adversarial fixture verifying that skipped tests are rejected as RED. The harness suite itself must execute with zero skips.
Requires a disposable Redis. scripts/quality/with-test-db.sh now provisions PostgreSQL and Redis together and CI runs a Redis service, so the test executes in every canonical run (0 skips accounted).
